response.sql: WITH media_type_rates AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS rate FROM MediaType AS m JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) SELECT Name, rate, rate - (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM media_type_rates) AS amount_above_average FROM media_type_rates WHERE rate > (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM media_type_rates);
